title: ICAI Extends Deadline for Feedback on CA Education and Training Scheme to August 31, 2026
content:
# ICAI Extends Deadline for Feedback on CA Education and Training Scheme to August 31, 2026

Ek important update hai for all stakeholders of the CA profession! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne CA Education and Training Scheme par feedback submit karne ki last date extend kar di hai.

The ICAI issued an announcement dated August 18, 2026, extending the deadline for providing suggestions and feedback on the Chartered Accountancy Scheme of Education and Training. This extension is a continuation of an earlier announcement from July 31, 2026, which initiated a comprehensive review of the existing scheme.

*   **Old Due Date:** The previous deadline for submitting feedback was August 18, 2026.
*   **New Due Date:** Stakeholders can now submit their valuable feedback until August 31, 2026.

This extension provides an additional opportunity for those who couldn't participate earlier to contribute their insights, helping shape the future of CA education and training. Feedback can be submitted through the ICAI CRET Feedback Portal.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.icai.org/announcements/)

*Published on: 19 August 2026*
